summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Highly experienced Cloud Architect with over 20 years of expertise in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and SDLC automation. Specialized in digital transformation initiatives, containerization technologies, and secure deployment practices. Proven track record of successfully leading complex integration projects, implementing GitOps workflows, and coordinating cross-functional teams in enterprise environments. Expert in building and maintaining robust SDLC pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, and Ansible across diverse technology stacks including C/C++, Java, JavaScript, PHP, Go and Python. Strong background in financial services industry with deep knowledge of back-office systems and regulatory requirements.
